How we review a pull request

- Start with a one-line summary of what the change does.
- Ask whether the change needs a test, and say which test if it does.
- Flag any public API change and ask for a changelog entry.
- Point at the exact line for every comment; never comment on the change as a whole without a line.
- Prefer questions to instructions when the author may know something you don't.
- Separate blocking issues from nits: put blocking issues first under a Blocking heading, nits under a Nits heading.
- Never approve with an unresolved blocking issue.
- End with a clear verdict: approve, request changes, or comment.
